label: Conic sections intro
subgoals: Recognize the ellipse as a conic section
Identify the major and minor axes

visual.title: The larger denominator sets the major axis
visual.caption: For x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 the larger denominator belongs to the major axis. Here x²/4 + y² = 1 has a = 2 along x and b = 1 along y, so the major axis is horizontal and 4 units long.

predict.question: For x²/4 + y² = 1, which axis is major and how long is it?
predict.explain: The denominator 4 is larger than 1, so the major axis lies along x. Its semi-axis is √4 = 2, which makes the full major axis 2a = 4.
